rows.en: You've only just come up into space, but we have orders from HQ.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: The <cs(1)>Grados Empire<ce()>, long on the offensive against Earth, appears to be on the move.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: For those unaware: an independent empire beyond the Earth Sphere, out to invade Earth.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Grados aims to seize major cities on the ground and has even demanded the UCE surrender.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Naturally, the UCE has no intention whatsoever of giving in.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Now <mk(25,50,7,0)><ar(0,7,0,100)><mk(25,12.5,7,3,50)><ar(0,7,3,100)><mk(62.5,12.5,7,3,100)><ar(0,7,3,100)>we'll come under the <pic(1)><cs(3)>Peacemillion<ce()>'s command and help destroy the enemy satellites.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: This is your first space battle, an unfamiliar one, so I want you to proceed with care.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: That mission was not on the schedule, but good work.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: The operation worked and Grados withdrew. They likely won't move in earnest for a while.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: What concerns me more is the Titans. They're stepping up activity in space as well...
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: Parts of the Moon are under their control too. We'd best assume something will happen.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?

rows.en: If you're defeated, it's all for nothing. Approach your operations with more care.
rows.speaker: Lucrezia Noin?
